mind-poisoning.description: BETA CANDIDATE 0.1.26: identity-checked gossip and reflection can influence CHIM opinions. Optional default-off recognition records an NPC's own current intimacy report separately from affinity and emotional type, with bounded private context, read-only API v1 and dashboard history. Reports do not establish mutual agreement or current willingness. Arrangements follow restored plugin state under either restore policy. Deterministic source, storage and optional SHARMAT-consumer fixtures passed; real-model interpretation, installed behavior and gameplay remain unverified. Standard release classification supports discovery without promoting maturity.
